app.name: Trailpack
app.tagline: Drop in your documents. Walk out ready.

create.title: Create your account

create.planBody: Daily model budget set by the invite. You can switch to DeepSeek Flash any time.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to keep walking your trail.
login.failed: Email or password is wrong. Try again.

me.title: Me
me.studyLanguageHelp: The language study material is generated in. Facts and progress stay the same.
me.themeHelp: Colours for the whole app. The choice is saved to your account.
me.themeSystemHelp: Follow the device setting (Grape Night or Sunrise).
me.syncNever: Not synced on this device yet

me.modelMuseHelp: Best for feedback, critique and follow up questions.
me.modelDeepseekHelp: Faster and cheaper. Good for reading documents and making cards in bulk.

me.deleteHelp: This deletes the account and every byte synced to the server. It cannot be undone.

me.signOutHelp: Signing out keeps your packs on this device.
me.signOutWipe: Also remove local data from this device
